data.content_ref: inline:The 'Variance Floor' mechanism in 00321f6b7b18 integrates with the 'Algorithmic Floor' effect in 051b3183aa966e6232f1e635aa7259bf92ad1c5ad996954879f69a27783391d3 by providing the social-verification layer (panel oversight) to the deterministic execution process (checklist). This relation is refuted if the 'Variance Floor' is found to be a purely individual cognitive effect rather than a collective panel effect.
